sample_unit: urological procedures (consent documents per arm, blind-rated by 3 urologists)

links.outcome: Blind expert-rated consent document quality of AI versus society standard forms and specialist documents
links.effect: LuminaConsent 82.33 (SD 4.2) vs society standard 78.77 (SD 6.1) and specialist documents 57.43 (SD 3.8); +4.5% over standards (p<0.05), +43.3% over specialists (p<0.001)
links.quote: LuminaConsent achieved higher performance with mean scores of 82.33 points (SD±4.2) versus 78.77 points (SD±6.1) for professional society standards and 57.43 points (SD±3.8) for specialist documentation, representing statistically significant improvements of 43.3% over specialist practices (p<0.001) and 4.5% over professional society standards (p<0.05).

unlisted_practices: Retrieval-augmented generation over curated clinical publications to draft informed consent documents

screen.reason: Evaluates a newly developed RAG-based AI system (LuminaConsent using GPT-4o-mini) against standard and specialist-authored informed consent forms via expert blind review, but does not test a specific operational deployment practice or guardrail comparison.
